This is my very first mod and a small tribute to "Legendary Legends" a mexican podcast about paranormal stuff and real crime. The mod itself only adds a new crop called "The Legendary Berry" which resembles the logo of the podcast. While the mod will make more sense if you talk spanish and know about the podcast, feel free to use it if you find the crop interesting, cute or just because you're a mod/crop hoarder :D

[b][u]Details:

[/u][/b]-Requires Json Assets.
-Seeds can be bought from Krobus for a mere 66 G
-Can be planted on summer and fall. Grows in 6 days and can harvest again once a week.
-Each berry sells for 66 G but each harvest yields at least 3 legendary berries.
-Loved by Abigail, Rasmodius and Krobus.

Note: In the object description "Peculiar" is misspelled purposefully, since the main host of the podcast has dyslexia and it's a word he misspells a lot. If this bothers you, you can manually fix the spelling in the object.json included in the mod.

[b][u]Future plans:[/u][/b]

-Add letters from the podcast hosts using MFM to get seeds for free.
-Add other macabre crops-
-Create a separate mod that adds the three main hosts of the podcast as NPCs, and tune them so everyone can enjoy them even if they don't know the podcast.

[/spoiler][/size]
